verdict.rationale: First-party docs say a Project can span multiple folders, such as a frontend and a backend repo, which gives agents the full codebase context. Conversations and agents run within these Projects, and the Project defines which folders and repositories they can access. This directly matches including multiple directories in one session. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of how folders are added or changed mid-session and of any limits (including CLI parity).
